title: Understanding the Data
text: The table shows tweets with counts of happy and sad emojis, along with a label indicating if the tweet is happy (1) or sad (0).

title: Logistic Regression and Regularization
text: Logistic regression with L2 regularization adds a penalty to the loss function to prevent overfitting. This penalty is proportional to the square of the coefficient values.

title: Effect of Large Lambda
text: A large lambda value in L2 regularization will shrink the coefficients towards zero, affecting the decision boundary's slope.

title: Impact on Training Error
text: With a large lambda, the model becomes less flexible. How does this affect the training error?
